sheet_log.notes: This is a miscellaneous details sheet (A-401) for Crow Holdings Industrial project on Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Sheet contains 13 details at various scales. No printed area or linear totals for CMU walls, exposed structure, tilt-up walls, or sealed concrete floor are shown on this details sheet - those quantities would be derived from floor plan and elevation sheets. The CMU wall at the pump/electrical room (Detail 5) is 8" block; no overall dimensions of that room are shown on this sheet. Dock leveler details (1, 2, 3) are labeled FUTURE.
